note: THE ESCAPE BOTH READERS ALREADY AGREE ABOUT, recorded because it is the trap next to this item: `\\x' consumes hex digits GREEDILY, so "a\\x41b" is not "aAb" -- Emacs answers (2 1051), a two-character string whose second character is U+041B. kg reads the same greedy sequence and then refuses it for a different reason (`character above 255 in string': a kg string is fe's unibyte byte string since Phase 25). So this divergence is NOT the unknown-escape item and must not be closed by it; it is the multibyte-string one, already recorded by the `frontier-multibyte-string-p' row.
